sanskrit_text: ईशावास्यमिदं सर्वं यत्किञ्च जगत्यां जगत् । तेन त्यक्तेन भुञ्जीथा मा गृधः कस्य स्विद्धनम् ॥
transliteration: īśāvāsyam idaṃ sarvaṃ yat kiñca jagatyāṃ jagat | tena tyaktena bhuñjīthā mā gṛdhaḥ kasya svid dhanam ||
translation: All that exists in this universe is pervaded by the Lord. Enjoy through renunciation; do not covet the wealth of others.
question: How should I live in the world without feeling that everything belongs to me?

sanskrit_text: कुर्वन्नेवेह कर्माणि जिजीविषेच्छतं समाः । एवं त्वयि नान्यथेतोऽस्ति न कर्म लिप्यते नरे ॥
transliteration: kurvann eveha karmāṇi jijīviṣec chataṃ samāḥ | evaṃ tvayi nānyatheto'sti na karma lipyate nare ||
translation: By performing one's duties here, one may wish to live a hundred years; thus action does not bind.
question: How can I live a full life while constantly performing my responsibilities?

sanskrit_text: असुर्या नाम ते लोका अन्धेन तमसाऽवृताः । ताँस्ते प्रेत्याभिगच्छन्ति ये के चात्महनो जनाः ॥
transliteration: asuryā nāma te lokā andhena tamasāvṛtāḥ | tāṃs te pretyābhigacchanti ye ke cātmahano janāḥ ||
translation: Those worlds are enveloped in darkness where people go who destroy the Self.
question: What happens when a person ignores self-reflection and inner growth?

sanskrit_text: अनेजदेकं मनसो जवीयो नैनद्देवा आप्नुवन्पूर्वमर्षत् । तद्धावतोऽन्यानत्येति तिष्ठत्तस्मिन्नपो मातरिश्वा दधाति ॥
transliteration: anejad ekaṃ manaso javīyo nainad devā āpnuvan pūrvam arṣat | tad dhāvato'nyān atyeti tiṣṭhat tasminn apo mātariśvā dadhāti ||
translation: The One moves not, yet is swifter than the mind; it surpasses all who run.
question: Why does the ultimate truth seem unreachable despite constant effort?

sanskrit_text: तदेजति तन्नैजति तद्दूरे तद्वन्तिके । तदन्तरस्य सर्वस्य तदु सर्वस्य बाह्यतः ॥
transliteration: tad ejati tan naijati tad dūre tad vantike | tad antar asya sarvasya tad u sarvasya bāhyataḥ ||
translation: It moves and moves not; it is far and near; it is within all and outside all.
question: How can something be both inside everything and beyond everything?

sanskrit_text: यस्तु सर्वाणि भूतानि आत्मन्येवानुपश्यति । सर्वभूतेषु चात्मानं ततो न विजुगुप्सते ॥
transliteration: yas tu sarvāṇi bhūtāni ātmany evānupaśyati | sarva-bhūteṣu cātmānaṃ tato na vijugupsate ||
translation: He who sees all beings in the Self and the Self in all beings feels no hatred.
question: How should I treat others if all beings are essentially one?

sanskrit_text: यस्मिन्सर्वाणि भूतानि आत्मैवाभूद्विजानतः । तत्र को मोहः कः शोक एकत्वमनुपश्यतः ॥
transliteration: yasmin sarvāṇi bhūtāni ātmaivābhūd vijānataḥ | tatra ko mohaḥ kaḥ śoka ekatvam anupaśyataḥ ||
translation: For one who sees unity, what delusion or sorrow can exist?
question: Why do fear and sorrow disappear when one understands unity?

sanskrit_text: स पर्यगाच्छुक्रमकायमव्रणमस्नाविरं शुद्धमपापविद्धम् । कविर्मनीषी परिभूः स्वयंभूः याथातथ्यतोऽर्थान् व्यदधाच्छाश्वतीभ्यः समाभ्यः ॥
transliteration: sa paryagāc chukram akāyam avraṇam asnāviram śuddham apāpa-viddham | kavir manīṣī paribhūḥ svayambhūḥ yāthātathyato'rthān vyadadhāc chāśvatībhyaḥ samābhyaḥ ||
translation: The Self is pure, bodiless, flawless, all-knowing, and self-existent.
question: What is the true nature of the Self beyond the physical body?

sanskrit_text: अन्धं तमः प्रविशन्ति येऽविद्यामुपासते । ततो भूय इव ते तमो य उ विद्यायां रताः ॥
transliteration: andhaṃ tamaḥ praviśanti ye'vidyām upāsate | tato bhūya iva te tamo ya u vidyāyāṃ ratāḥ ||
translation: Those who worship ignorance enter darkness; those devoted only to knowledge enter deeper darkness.
question: Why is living without awareness considered dangerous?

sanskrit_text: अन्यदेवाहुर्विद्यया अन्यदाहुरविद्यया । इति शुश्रुम धीराणां ये नस्तद्विचचक्षिरे ॥
transliteration: anyad evāhur vidyayā anyad āhur avidyayā | iti śuśruma dhīrāṇāṃ ye nas tad vicacakṣire ||
translation: Different results are said to come from knowledge and ignorance.
question: How are the results of knowledge different from the results of ignorance?

sanskrit_text: विद्यां चाविद्यां च यस्तद्वेदोभयं सह । अविद्यया मृत्युं तीर्त्वा विद्ययाऽमृतमश्नुते ॥
transliteration: vidyāṃ cāvidyāṃ ca yas tad vedobhayaṃ saha | avidyayā mṛtyuṃ tīrtvā vidyayāmṛtam aśnute ||
translation: One who knows both knowledge and ignorance transcends death and attains immortality.
question: How can I balance material life with spiritual understanding?

sanskrit_text: अन्धं तमः प्रविशन्ति येऽसम्भूतिमुपासते । ततो भूय इव ते तमो य उ सम्भूत्यां रताः ॥
transliteration: andhaṃ tamaḥ praviśanti ye asambhūtim upāsate | tato bhūya iva te tamo ya u sambhūtyāṃ ratāḥ ||
translation: Those who worship the unmanifest enter darkness; those devoted only to the manifest enter greater darkness.
question: Why is exclusive attachment to the visible world discouraged?

sanskrit_text: अन्यदेवाहुः सम्भवात् अन्यदाहुरसम्भवात् । इति शुश्रुम धीराणां ये नस्तद्विचचक्षिरे ॥
transliteration: anyad evāhuḥ sambhavāt anyad āhur asambhavāt | iti śuśruma dhīrāṇāṃ ye nas tad vicacakṣire ||
translation: Different results arise from manifest and unmanifest worship.
question: Why does focusing on only one aspect of life lead to incomplete understanding?

sanskrit_text: सम्भूतिं च विनाशं च यस्तद्वेदोभयं सह । विनाशेन मृत्युं तीर्त्वा सम्भूत्याऽमृतमश्नुते ॥
transliteration: sambhūtiṃ ca vināśaṃ ca yas tad vedobhayaṃ saha | vināśena mṛtyuṃ tīrtvā sambhūtyāmṛtam aśnute ||
translation: Knowing both creation and destruction, one transcends death.
question: How does understanding creation and destruction help overcome fear of death?

sanskrit_text: हिरण्मयेन पात्रेण सत्यस्यापिहितं मुखम् । तत्त्वं पूषन्नपावृणु सत्यधर्माय दृष्टये ॥
transliteration: hiraṇmayena pātreṇa satyasyāpihitaṃ mukham | tat tvaṃ pūṣann apāvṛṇu satya-dharmāya dṛṣṭaye ||
translation: The face of truth is hidden by a golden vessel; remove it, O Sun.
question: Why is truth often hidden behind attractive external appearances?

sanskrit_text: पूषन्नेकर्षे यम सूर्य प्राजापत्य व्यूह रश्मीन् । समूह तेजो यत्ते रूपं कल्याणतमं तत्ते पश्यामि ॥
transliteration: pūṣann ekarṣe yama sūrya prājāpatya vyūha raśmīn | samūha tejo yat te rūpaṃ kalyāṇatamaṃ tat te paśyāmi ||
translation: O Sun, withdraw your rays so that I may see your auspicious form.
question: How can I move beyond superficial perception to gain true insight?

sanskrit_text: वायुरनिलममृतमत्थेदं भस्मान्तं शरीरम् । ॐ क्रतो स्मर कृतं स्मर क्रतो स्मर कृतं स्मर ॥
transliteration: vāyur anilam amṛtam atha idaṃ bhasmāntaṃ śarīram | oṃ krato smara kṛtaṃ smara krato smara kṛtaṃ smara ||
translation: Let the breath return to the immortal; the body ends in ashes.
question: What remains meaningful when the body is temporary and perishable?

sanskrit_text: अग्ने नय सुपथा राये अस्मान् विश्वानि देव वयुनानि विद्वान् । युयोध्यस्मज्जुहुराणमेनो भूयिष्ठां ते नमउक्तिं विधेम ॥
transliteration: agne naya supathā rāye asmān viśvāni deva vayunāni vidvān | yuyodhy asmaj juhurāṇam eno bhūyiṣṭhāṃ te nama-uktiṃ vidhema ||
translation: O Fire, lead us by the good path to prosperity, knowing all deeds.
question: How can I be guided toward the right path in life when I feel confused?
